newsitem.title: USA: CMS expands, reorganizes energy marketing.
newsitem.headline: CMS expands, reorganizes energy marketing.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp said it is expanding and reorganizing its energy marketing business under a new company, CMS Marketing, Services and Trading.
The new business unit will be in full operation by January 1, the company said.

CMS Marketing, Services and Trading will provide natural gas, electric, oil and coal marketing, risk management and energy management services to industrial, commercial and municipal energy users throughout the United States and eventually world wide.

Formed in a consolidation of its predecessor company, CMS Gas and Electric Marketing, with resources from the marketing areas of corporate affiliates Consumers Power and CMS NOMECO Oil & Gas, the new company will provide energy management and fuel procurement services through a broad range of fuels domestically and internationally.
"We believe the customer wants BTUs of reliable energy at the least expensive price available, whether it is in the form of electricity, gas, coal or oil," explained CMS.

"As the U.S. electric industry prepares for restructuring, this expansion of CMS Energy's marketing functions and their consolidation under one organization will provide greater management focus, efficiency and accountability. This restructuring will significantly improve CMS Energy's competitive position in the energy marketplace throughout the U.S. and abroad," the company said.

CMS Marketing, Services and Trading will function in three areas -- electricity and fuels marketing and brokering to end-use and wholesale customers; energy management services including in-plant efficiency optimization as well as total energy management including fuel procurement; and, risk management including hedging, arbitrage and trading.
